arguments.question: Assess whether hardware input costs, optical-component availability, power/cooling constraints, or supplier purchase commitments are material to ANET’s 5-, 21- and 63-session thesis. Focus on issuer-disclosed mechanisms: product gross-margin sensitivity, inventory/non-cancelable commitments, component lead times and the 1.6 Tbps/liquid-cooled AI-fabric rollout. Distinguish a commodity-price channel from semiconductor/optics supply and from data-center power availability; quantify only issuer-disclosed amounts or ranges. Deliver observable conditions that would change the operating or valuation cases. Stop after pertinent 2026 filing/results passages; if direct commodity exposure is not disclosed, state that and avoid proxy-price attribution.
arguments.decision_impact: Determines whether a materials, component, energy or commitment channel materially changes ANET’s operating cases, while preventing unsupported commodity-price causality.
